_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for ELCV targets. NEVER hardcode a target in code or a spec. A scope with "locked": true may be RAISED but never lowered, removed, or unlocked, UNLESS this file carries a top-level "unlock": "<reason>" override (a conscious, reviewed action). Enforced as a hard gate by .githooks/check-elcv-targets.py. Global USO de-duplication runs across the whole codebase, so scopes can never duplicate each other's logic — zero overlap/conflict/bloat is enforced.

repo.note: Whole-repo target = 2,000,000,000 ELCV (the mission goal). Every counted unit is USO-unique across the entire codebase: no duplication, no conflict, no overlap, no vendor code, no bloat. Equals the global ceiling — the whole repo grows into the full 2B of distinct, behaviorally-unique logic.
